rationale: The desired postcondition (res.deep_view() == self.deep_view()) is already specified by the ToOwned trait in contrib::exec_spec, so adding the same ensures on this impl is redundant and triggers the checker/harness issues (missing DeepViewClone import, private seq module). Skip adding a duplicate per-impl spec and rely on the trait-level contract.
risks: Leaving the impl without an explicit per-impl ensures means the verifier will use the trait-level postcondition; if that trait contract is incorrect it affects callers.
The impl is marked external_body; verifier trusts the body regardless—external-body trust remains a risk but is not a reason to duplicate the same trait-level postcondition.
